seo.title: Cinema Museum Ouarzazate | Film History | MoroccoTripMap
seo.description: Visit the Cinema Museum in Ouarzazate: costumes, posters and props tracing the region as Morocco’s film capital.
seo.keywords: Cinema Museum Ouarzazate, Musée du Cinéma Ouarzazate

name: Musée du Cinéma
hero_subtitle: Costumes, props and posters — Ouarzazate’s film story indoors, away from studio heat.

overview.title: The story behind the sets
overview.p1: The Cinema Museum complements Atlas Studios with costumes, equipment and archives explaining why directors return to Ouarzazate.
overview.p2: A good heat-escape stop; pairs with Kasbah Taourirt.

q1.question: Same as Atlas Studios?
q1.answer: No — museum is history and objects; studios are outdoor sets.

q2.question: Interesting for non-film fans?
q2.answer: Moderately — best if you already visit Studios.
